prompt: In the revised notice, a sentence may be attributed to a named source only when that person has checked the revised wording, and a checked sentence may still appear without a name if the source approved anonymous publication only. Mara approved anonymous publication of the revised first sentence; Leon approved being named but checked only its earlier wording. The editor may now _____.
promptZh: 更正公告中的句子，只有在具名來源確認過修訂文字後才能署名；若來源只同意匿名刊登，已確認的句子仍可匿名刊出。瑪拉同意匿名刊登修訂後的第一句；里昂同意具名，但只看過該句的舊版。編輯現在可_____。

options.text: publish the revised sentence without naming either source
options.zh: 刊登修訂後的句子，但不公開任何一位來源的姓名
options.whyZh: 瑪拉已核對修改後的文字並同意匿名刊出；里昂並未核對新版，不能為新版具名。

options.text: publish the revised sentence naming Mara alone
options.zh: 刊登修訂後的句子，僅列瑪拉姓名
options.whyZh: 瑪拉只授權匿名，不可即使核對了新版就列她姓名。

options.text: publish the revised sentence naming Leon alone
options.zh: 刊登修訂後的句子，僅列里昂姓名
options.whyZh: 里昂同意的是具名，卻沒核對修訂文字；兩項授權缺一不可。

options.text: publish the earlier wording and attribute the revised wording to both sources
options.zh: 先刊登舊版文字，再把修訂版歸於兩位具名來源
options.whyZh: 先列舊版不會補足修訂版的授權，瑪拉仍未同意具名，里昂仍沒核對新版。

explanationZh: 瑪拉已核對修改後的文字並同意匿名刊出；里昂並未核對新版，不能為新版具名。
evidence: only when that person has checked the revised wording / Mara approved anonymous publication / Leon approved being named but checked only its earlier wording

vocabulary.note: 在編輯與引述語境中，用來連結文字和其消息來源。
